title: Full-Term Rate Used for Coverage Returns After Package Changes and Restorations
content:
**Rule.** Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the full-term rate of the coverage return is the rate on the coverage's latest premium charge, latest by effective date:
- **Package change.** When that latest charge is a package change, the rate is the full-term rate on that package-change charge. A package change and a restoration sharing the latest effective date count as the package change.
- **Restoration.** When the latest charge is a restoration after a reinstatement of the owner term, the rate is the full-term rate on that restoration charge.
- **Coverage-added charge only.** When the only charge is the coverage-added charge, the rate is its full-term rate.

| Premium charges on the coverage (hypothetical) | Full-term rate used |
|---|---|
| Coverage added in March; package change effective in June | The rate on the June package-change charge |
| Coverage added; package change effective the 5th; restoration effective the 19th | The rate on the restoration charge |
| Package change and restoration both effective the 19th | The rate on the package-change charge |
| Coverage-added charge only | The coverage-added rate |
